note: honest guesses fixed before any run; the question is whether the parameter recruited for a class is decided at initialisation (the small-initialisation theory's lottery: the neuron already most aligned with the feature wins) or recruited later by the states

L1.text: at step 0 the eventual row's rank among all rows by cosine with its final class direction is at chance on all three seeds: median normalised rank between 0.35 and 0.65 and top-100 share 0.02 or less

L2.text: at step 0 the eventual row's rank by activation selectivity for its class positions (the read side) is at chance by the same criteria

L3.text: the lineage, the row staying in the top tenth of rows by cosine with the class direction, begins at step 1000 or later for most eventual words, not in the log-spaced steps up to 512

L4.text: the step-0 rank does not predict the recruitment checkpoint (Spearman between -0.15 and 0.15)

B1.text: two checkpoints before recruitment the recruit's read-weight norm exceeds the median of its ten nearest competitors' for 0.6 or more of the eventual words (Wang 2026: the balance of input and output weights decides which aligned neuron takes the feature)

B2.text: its write-column norm does not: the share is 0.55 or less (e572: a large row but not because it is large)

C1.text: given the class, the recruit is in the top ten of non-word rows by mean class ratio for 0.7 or more two checkpoints before, and in the top ten by usage, which is class-blind, for 0.3 or fewer

X1.text: with the row's own write subtracted from the class states, the step-0 normalised rank by cosine stays below 0.2: the ticket is real, not the row's own persistence

X2.text: cross-seed: for seed 0's classes carried to seeds 1 and 2 by position, the speaker row found there has a step-0 normalised rank below 0.2 in its own seed, where the circularity cannot arise

X3.text: recruited rows rotate no more than typical rows from step 0 to recruitment: their cosine with their step-0 direction is within 0.05 of the median over all rows

v2_note: after the smoke run (seed 0, classes defined at step 4000, 111 words) showed the eventual row at a step-0 normalised rank of 0.04 by cosine with its class direction against 0.50 for a random row, three controls were added before the full runs: the class direction with the row's own write subtracted, a cross-seed test in which the classes come from another seed's rows, and the persistence of the recruited rows against all rows; L1 to L4 stand as first registered
